name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer focused on the 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The 79-square-kilometre property hosts high-grade silver-gold mineralization at the Oculto deposit and received approval under Argentina's RIGI investment regime in 2026. The company is advancing toward a construction decision, with active drilling and updated resource estimates completed.
